lines.en: Pale blue crystals stud my hide.
Every step catches light.
I walk slowly so nothing chips.
My shadow has a blue rim.
The crystals click softly together.
I go deeper, and shine brighter.
The stone under me reflects.
Each step leaves a blue glint.
I step around the hard stones.
The crystals are slowly growing.
I stopped and looked a while.
All of this is heavy.
The crystal edges pinch me.
I pass and the light stays behind.
Hard light aches in my crystals.
I drag all this light forward.
I stand; light turns inside the crystals.
The blue on me is cold.
I wait for somewhere deep.
The crystals grow a little at a time.
I'm hard, and brittle.
I shudder and chips fall.
It's dark around; only I shine.
I shine even standing still.

lines.zh: 这块石头里没有别的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing else in this stone.

lines.zh: 我在数自己身上几块晶。
lines.en: I'm counting my crystals.
My crystal faces show me my own face.
Light passes through the crystal gaps.
The deep's cold has frozen me blue.

lines.zh: 这里安静得能听见晶响。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear the crystals.
I've hidden deep a long while.
I haven't found a good place yet.
Don't point that pick at me.
This hide of mine is harder than stone.
Watching me must hurt your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: You carry iron. I'm not fond of it.
Want to mine me? You can't.
I shine to frighten people.
Stand back. The glare is sharp.
I don't hurt anyone. I change stone.
There's blue dust on your soles.

lines.zh: 你的护甲反着我身上的光。
lines.en: Your armor reflects my light.
I'm judging whether this patch will do.
The dark would be safer for you.
A crystal came off.
The crack runs into the crystal and brightens it.
My blue dimmed for an instant.
You have crystal dust on your hands.

lines.zh: 我退了一点，地上有亮屑。
lines.en: I moved back, bright chips behind.
Each hit grows another layer of crystal.
The light inside spilled out.
A new crack on me.
All that came off was broken light.
Only my color went cloudy.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西太小了。
lines.en: That in your hand is far too small.
I don't eat. I grow crystals.
That diamond glare makes me squint.
The glimmer in your hand is too thin.
Keep it away. I'm swelling.
Trade that for my life?

lines.zh: 你手上的东西比我还亮。
lines.en: What you hold is brighter than me.

lines.zh: 我身上这些都是自己长的。
lines.en: All of this grew on me.
Keep it. It's more use to you.
Not trading. Just looking.
That one's facets are very clean.
Stay back or it'll scratch.
I don't like touching iron.
Don't touch — my crystal edges cut.
Diamond doesn't conduct. I know.

lines.zh: 这东西放地上会被人捡。
lines.en: Leave that down and someone will take it.
Hitting me is like hitting glass.
That left a scratch on you.
Crystal chips caught your clothes.
Don't crowd. I'll crack.

lines.zh: 你退开，我身上的光晃你。
lines.en: Step back; my light flickers at you.
I'm cold and hard.
You knocked a crystal off me.
A small blue patch on the ground.
I can barely keep my footing.
Another touch and a piece breaks.

lines.zh: 这些晶不是为这个长的。
lines.en: These crystals weren't grown for this.
Two of us together would shatter.
This must be unpleasant to watch.
One touch and chips come off.
It's brighter than I am.
The light on the ground scatters wildly.
We left pieces all over the ground.
We don't count as breeding.
Crisp, unpleasant sound.
Afterwards neither of us has more.
I pick up a blue stone.
This is smaller than my own.
I lifted it and the light dimmed.

lines.zh: 它在我手里不那么亮了。
lines.en: It's dimmer in my hand.
My hand is too hard to grip well.
There are crystal shards on the ground.
I'll keep this to grow onto me.
I pushed it into the stone.
Bend once and a crystal chips.
A little dust came off that of yours.
The stone you're on is valuable.
I see you. You stand out.
I'm coming toward you slowly.
I'll turn this ground to diamond.
Small range, but you're too close.
My light is growing.
The ground under you is glinting.
I count to three and start swelling.
This stone is suitable.
The further you retreat, the safer.
Each footfall lights the stone.
You hid behind the stone pillar.

lines.zh: 我跟着你身上的蓝粉走。
lines.en: I follow the blue dust you leave.
There should be blue deep in this grey.
I'm slow, but my light won't go out.

lines.zh: 你退到暗处我看不清了。
lines.en: In the dark I lose you.

lines.zh: 我身上的光暴露了自己。
lines.en: My own light gives me away.

lines.zh: 我的光只够照亮一个坑。
lines.en: My light lasts for exactly one crater.
You've fallen back to the stone wall.
I edge along the wall.
I burst and the rubble is full of light.

lines.zh: 这一炸，只为换掉这层岩。
lines.en: This blast is only to swap out this rock layer.
Crystal chips struck your face.
Shards spray out; you back away.

lines.zh: 这一圈全变成钻石矿了。
lines.en: The whole ring turned to diamond ore.
My hide split and blue light spilled.
A shard lodged in your armor.
The grass is all buried now.
My crystals are shedding grit.
The hole's edge is sharp.
I lit up out of the rock layer.
There's diamond down here.
I flashed on landing.
A dot of blue appeared on the wall.
I can see things in the dark.
The stone on this level is hard.
I stood and a crystal rang.
A point of blue kindles in the dark.
You've been mining up there.
Someone has seen my light.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的蓝光就浊了。
lines.en: Fire clouded my blue.
I shattered into a handful of crystal.

lines.zh: 水一泡，光就透不出来了。
lines.en: Water soaked in and the light stopped.

lines.zh: 两股气一起冲，石头翻了。
lines.en: Both bursts went off and the stone flipped.
The arrow cracked a whole crystal.

lines.zh: 这光让我的晶一下变白了。
lines.en: That light turned the crystals white.
I don't eat. Only stone.

lines.zh: 雷进了晶体，我全身发白。
lines.en: Lightning enters my crystals; I blaze white.

lines.zh: 这下面空得连岩层都没有。
lines.en: Down here there isn't even rock to change.
